frozen._max_gross_stress_note: C4's OWN GROSS CAP (team lead 2026-10-26: 'its own gross cap'), DERIVED, NOT CHOSEN, by the frozen rule that set the core's 1.80 (PREREG_GROUP_CAP_2026-09-16 §3b, applied for Alpaca in PREREG_ALPACA_V7_2026-09-28 §3b, CEF trial 50): G_stress = (NLV - M_other)/(m + w5)/E_book, floored to 0.05 after subtracting the mark sensitivity. UNITS: a MULTIPLE of sleeve NAV, applied to gross = sum|w| of the HELD book after the band by one uniform f = cap/gross in (0,1); it only scales down and never flattens. INPUTS: NLV $100,000 and M_other $0 are RULINGS, not reads (C4's own $100k in its own account, team lead 2026-10-26; no broker is called in this step, and since 2026-10-28 the agent lab shares the account but holds nothing there yet); m = 0.50, Reg T initial, the core's ruled input (all 74 marginable at 30% maintenance at the frozen 2026-10-14T21:40:33Z read [V]); E_book $100,000 = capital_usd; w5 = 0.0261393, the worst 5-session total-return loss per unit gross held of C4's UNCAPPED 4.8% band on CRSP ret over its fit window 2005-02-22..2022-12-30, the five sessions ending 2008-07-23 (IGR, RQI and RNP held short and rising every day; a direct second computation agrees to 1e-12; next worst 0.0244 ending 2020-03-17 and 0.0242 ending 2009-04-08). The method first reproduces the core's recorded 13-name w5, 0.0425814 ending 2020-03-18, on panels cut at 2022-12-30. G_stress = 1.900638; no mark sensitivity (no other book's margin) -> floor_0.05 = 1.90. NOT CHOSEN: the core's 1.80 (copying it would size 74 other funds to the 13's worst week), 1.9006 itself (no room for its own movement), and no cap (the uncapped band reaches 3.20x and is above 1.90x on 34.1% of fit sessions). PLATEAU (fit gross SR; the value comes from the arithmetic, not from this): 1.60 1.247, 1.70 1.233, 1.80 1.217, 1.90 1.200, 2.00 1.185, none 1.137, a slope with no cliff. KNOWN LIMITS, accepted knowingly: (1) THIN HEADROOM: a worst week above w5 = 0.0263158 gives 1.85, and the fit's sits 0.0001765 below it; (2) w5 is the fit window only, where the core's read ran to its panel end; C4's 2023-26 returns are not read here; (3) NLV and M_other are rulings: re-derive by this rule from a fresh probe at arming (plan §2 step 6), with the lab's margin as M_other and its mark sensitivity once the lab trades; (4) while below_min_names = hold lasts the cap is effectively off (declared). DIVERGES FROM THE TRIAL'S BOOK, which capped at the core's 1.80: fit gross SR 1.200 total / 1.344 price-only here against 1.217 / 1.360 (results/cef/c4/c4_paper_benchmark_2026-10-29.txt §4). READ BY cef_discount.py (_max_gross_stress, _cap_gross) and, once a C4 book exists, quantt/session/run.py spec_params. Reproducer: python3 scripts/cef/c4_paper_benchmark.py run. REVERT: delete the key = no cap (3.20x reachable); 1.8 is the trial's own book, which this rule does not give.

rebalance._min_trade_usd_note: RE-DERIVED BY THE CORE'S RULE (cef_discount.frozen.json _min_trade_note): N solves F + N*hs = N*30bp, with F the fixed cost per order. Alpaca charges no commission per order, so F = 0 and N = 0: the same broker gives the same answer. The only floor is one whole share. UNITS: USD. READ BY quantt/session/run.py spec_params, once a C4 book exists. REVERT: n/a.

risk._max_gross_exposure_usd_note: THE CORE'S RULE, 2.6x capital_usd (carried from v6's $1.3M on $500k into v7's $260k on $100k), at C4's $100k: a dollar backstop that gate 8 reads after the orders fill (quantt/session/gate.py). max_gross_stress (1.90x = $190k) is the binding ceiling. NOT CHOSEN: max_gross_stress x capital ($190k), because while below_min_names = hold lasts the held book may drift above the cap (declared), and a gate set at the cap would refuse those days. UNITS: USD. READ BY quantt/session/run.py spec_params, once a C4 book exists. REVERT: n/a (new spec).
risk._drawdown_levels_note: NO halve_drawdown OR kill_drawdown, ON PURPOSE. C4's stop rule (team lead 2026-10-26; PREREG_C4 §14, H11; kill_rule below) is re-measured on its read date (H14), and the core's 0.12 / 0.18 were set for another book and are read in report mode only (quantt/session/drawdown.py). Copying them would put a number no derivation supports beside a rule that forbids one. Absent, drawdown.levels raises Unmeasured, which report mode records and never acts on, and a book json without risk.drawdown never runs it. The C4 book json (plan §2 step 5) decides.

kill_rule: C4's stop rule (team lead 2026-10-26, docs/SYSTEM.md §5; PREREG_C4 §14, H11). HALT on a fidelity break: the live target must equal the trial script's target on the same panel outside the declared divergences (scripts/cef/c4_paper_benchmark.py). REVERSE at 120 armed sessions if the live cumulative gross return on the official-fill line is below the 5th percentile of the trial's own 120-session cumulative PRICE-ONLY returns (paper credits shorts no distribution), re-measured on the read date by stationary bootstrap (mean block 21) on the fit and holdout series; total return is read against the distribution-adjusted line beside it. REVERSE at any time on a live drawdown past the fit's worst, re-measured. No threshold is written here (H14). Reported, no rule: the live daily correlation with the core book. ACTED ON BY nothing yet (dark).
